# External expert benchmark

cuad_expert_test.jsonl: 3,420 contract/category tasks, 95 mapped held-out contracts, 36 substantive categories, 825 positive and 2,595 negative/impossible tasks. Source: CUAD v1 expert annotations. Use for clause/evidence validation and external comparison, not custom risk ground truth.

cuad_test_presence_gold.csv is a secondary project-test-derived presence artifact; do not use it as the primary risk benchmark because the clause-row representation is not a full contract/category grid.
